#include <assert.h>

static int32_t c_visitor_visitor_skip_code_blocks_visit_code_block(const HTMHtmContext* _ctx, void* _user_data, const char* _lang, const char* _code, char** out_custom, size_t* out_len) {
    (void)_ctx;
    (void)_user_data;
    (void)out_custom;
    (void)out_len;
    (void)_lang;
    (void)_code;
    return 2;
}

int main(void) {

    /* Visitor skips code blocks from output */

    HTMHtmVisitorCallbacks _callbacks;
    memset(&_callbacks, 0, sizeof(_callbacks));
    _callbacks.visit_code_block = c_visitor_visitor_skip_code_blocks_visit_code_block;

    HTMAlefHandle _visitor = htm_visitor_create(&_callbacks);
    assert(_visitor != 0 && "visitor create failed");

    HTMAlefHandle _options = htm_conversion_options_from_json("{}");
    assert(_options != 0 && "options from_json failed");

    htm_options_set_visitor(_options, _visitor);

    HTMAlefHandle _result = htm_convert("<p>Intro text</p><pre><code>let x = 42;</code></pre><p>Outro text</p>", _options);
    assert(_result != 0 && "visitor call failed");

    htm_conversion_result_free(_result);
    htm_conversion_options_free(_options);
    htm_visitor_free(_visitor);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
